newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian shares dip in light trade.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian shares dip in light trade.

text.p: Lithuanian shares dipped in light trade on Monday, the Lithuanian National stock exchange said.
Overall central market volume was 433,455 litas and the group A index, which tracks the bourse's 35 most active listings, fell by 5.54 to 1535.5.
Birzai Milk dairy company continued to be active wtih turnover of 237,512 litas as it fell to eight litas from 8.68 litas.
Hermis Bank, one of the country's largest commercial banks, saw its shares rise to 163 litas from 152.5 in trade worth 26,243 litas.
Ukio Bank shares were the most active but it closed lower at 17.10 from 20 litas on turnover of 71,502 litas.

Block trades on Monday reached a large 4.07 million litas, led by shop equipment company Viranga which had 3.10 million litas of volume at price of 26.29 litas. Lithuanian Gas registered business of 56,694 litas at price range of 1.13 to one lita.
Volume on the secondary T-bill market reached 127,017 litas.
